A_system_transfer.title: System transfer
insert_caption: Two of three seed pairs win in each.
A_system_transfer.insert_protocol: 75M task frames · frozen DG 64 · one source per architecture
A_system_transfer.survey_subtitle: 3b  Does the trend hold within a family?
survey_caption: More peak bins do not imply more target hits.
Score–hit trends weaken within both families.
Historical hit counters; recent spatial windows.
A_system_transfer.claim: Joint DG–worker–graph transfer improves average adaptation reward, with seed-dependent outcomes.
A_system_transfer.takehome: Broader exploration, with seed-dependent system transfer.
A_system_transfer.question: Which interactions make a learned code reusable by its worker and graph?
A_system_transfer.risk: Reward gains are modest and heterogeneous. Two of three paired seeds favor WORKER in each architecture; there is no matched WORKER heldout evaluation. This tests a transferred package, not a DG-specific effect or equal total pretraining compute.

B_predictor_and_graph.title: Predictor and graph
B_predictor_and_graph.insert_title: 2c  A predictor can accompany more looping
insert_caption: Both directions hold in all three seed pairs.
Frozen 10k probes at the same 75M age.
B_predictor_and_graph.insert_protocol: DG 16 · already goal-conditioned · matched age, not identical paths
survey_caption: Stored connectivity does not verify executable edges.
B_predictor_and_graph.claim: Adding a goal predictor accompanies more short returns and less visited coverage in a matched three-seed contrast.
B_predictor_and_graph.takehome: Exploration and internal-model diagnostics can diverge.
B_predictor_and_graph.question: Can predicting familiar transitions stabilize cycles instead of discovery?
B_predictor_and_graph.risk: The predictor result comes from one architectural background and stochastic frozen probes. Graph correlations are descriptive, with heterogeneous outcome rules and ages across families; they do not identify a causal failure of graph connectivity.

C_fields_and_variant_means.title: Fields and variant means
insert_caption: Broad or multifield maps can still be spatial.
C_fields_and_variant_means.insert_protocol: DG 16 · three seeds · archived frozen maps · criterion-dependent
C_fields_and_variant_means.survey_subtitle: 3b  Average the three seeds of each variant
survey_caption: Three-seed averages retain the pooled pattern.
55 variants; one mixed-age variant is omitted.
C_fields_and_variant_means.claim: The coverage advantage does not coincide with more units passing the strict single-field criterion.
C_fields_and_variant_means.takehome: Broader exploration does not establish compact fields or goal control.
C_fields_and_variant_means.question: What field compactness is necessary for a useful internal goal?
C_fields_and_variant_means.risk: Very few units pass a stringent classification rule; the counts do not imply an absence of spatial coding or equivalence between designs. Averaging seeds repeats the same survey, rather than providing independent replication.
